name: fullstack-starter-kit
description: Production-ready MERN starter kit with refresh-token cookie auth.

scripts.lint: pnpm -C backend lint && pnpm -C frontend lint
scripts.test: concurrently "pnpm -C backend test" "pnpm -C frontend test" "pnpm -C packages/cli test"
scripts.test:coverage: concurrently "pnpm -C backend test:coverage" "pnpm -C frontend test:coverage" "pnpm -C packages/cli test:coverage"
